what: The author's audit of the article records counted in one run, used once as the critic's test (scripts/v9_critic_check.py --audit). Each counted record was read against its quotation; no gold label was used.

note: On 17 November, 3 of the other 39 records were noted as resting on weak quotations, without being named. They are among the 39 here, so a rejection of any of the 39 is read one by one and not scored as a false alarm automatically. The critic's instructions were written by someone who knew these five errors: the test says whether the critic applies the rule, not whether it would find a new kind of error.
